title: The octopus-push guard lets a bare git push through when the three-parent merge is already on a ref of the pushed remote
why:
Sighting (coordinator 16:40 CST Nov 14, from lane child-cites-degen's 16:40 report; the coordinator did not read the guard text; triage read no lane output; n=1): in degen, the lane's bare `git push` tripped the octopus-push guard on commit 67f96562758e, an old 3-parent merge already on origin/main; an explicit `HEAD:branch` push passed with no override. READ by triage (guard code and record, claude-settings main): decision octopus-push-refused says "A merge that a ref of the pushed remote already holds is not new, so a lane that merges in an old octopus passes". hooks/guard_merge.py `_octopus_hit` runs `git rev-list --merges --parents <source> --not --remotes=<remote>`, with remote = the push's named remote, else origin, and reads LOCAL remote-tracking refs only (no fetch). So the refusal contradicts the decision's intent if a ref of the pushed remote held 67f96562758e. VERDICT: unknown whether it is a false alarm by code; candidate causes, none confirmed: (a) the lane's local refs/remotes/origin/* did not hold the merge (stale, unfetched); (b) a bare push on a branch whose remote is not origin (listed as a not-read note in the decision: the guard reads origin while git pushes elsewhere); (c) the explicit push differed in its source or destination (a destination named like the default branch is skipped before any read). Rule: verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent. First act of a lane: read the decision octopus-push-refused and the guard's cases (hooks/test_guard.py octopus-push, tests/guard/s17973-octopus-push.py); ask the lane for its `git remote -v`, `git config branch.<name>.remote` and whether origin/main held 67f96562758e at the push; reproduce on a throwaway clone of a merge already on main, red then green. Kin: octopus-merge-push-refused (the build step).

[19:34 CST Nov 15, triage] Consultant ruled 19:35 CST Nov 15 (relayed via the coordinator, not read by triage): keep this step, retire octopus-push-remote-history. Facts moved from that step (relayed, unverified by triage): branch octopus-push-remote-history; a test-author is on it; PR number to follow; degen merge ddc7fa405 (3-parent merge already in degen origin/main); push 1bc168055; degen PRs 746 at 18:55 and 747 about 19:07 CST (lane tg-file-title-zero); refusal text not yet read. Owner chat (relayed 19:26 CST): "can you send a subagent on this after confirming degen coordinator's local experience on this?" Stable fix 7398a1e9a skips remote-reachable merges but misses this case; #2366 built the rule.
